method: One warm-up followed by five EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON) executions per case; server execution times; 100000 synthetic rows; isolated local audit schema. Foreign keys omitted from benchmark-only table.

before.postgresql: PostgreSQL 17.11 (Debian 17.11-1.pgdg12+2) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 12.2.0-14+deb12u1) 12.2.0, 64-bit
before.sql:
SELECT product_generations.user_id, product_generations.conversation_id, product_generations.product_id, product_generations.product_snapshot_id, product_generations.model_id, product_generations.model_name, product_generations.reasoning_effort, product_generations.request_key, product_generations.input_digest, product_generations.result_digest, product_generations.status, product_generations.message_count, product_generations.created_at, product_generations.finished_at, product_generations.history_invalidated_at, product_generations.answer_metadata, product_generations.answer_lease_until, product_generations.id 
FROM product_generations 
WHERE product_generations.status = $1::VARCHAR AND product_generations.answer_lease_until <= $2::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE ORDER BY product_generations.answer_lease_until 
 LIMIT $3::INTEGER

after.postgresql: PostgreSQL 17.11 (Debian 17.11-1.pgdg12+2) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 12.2.0-14+deb12u1) 12.2.0, 64-bit
after.sql:
SELECT product_generations.user_id, product_generations.conversation_id, product_generations.product_id, product_generations.product_snapshot_id, product_generations.model_id, product_generations.model_name, product_generations.reasoning_effort, product_generations.request_key, product_generations.input_digest, product_generations.result_digest, product_generations.status, product_generations.message_count, product_generations.created_at, product_generations.finished_at, product_generations.history_invalidated_at, product_generations.answer_metadata, product_generations.answer_lease_until, product_generations.id 
FROM product_generations 
WHERE product_generations.status = 'pending' AND product_generations.answer_lease_until <= $1::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE ORDER BY product_generations.answer_lease_until 
 LIMIT $2::INTEGER
